# mcahr_smtp_subscription (Resource)

SMTP Subscription resource for managing email notification subscriptions



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filters` (Attributes List) Filter rules that determine which events trigger notifications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `integration_name` (String) Name of the SMTP integration this subscription belongs to (cannot be modified after creation)
- `name` (String) Name of the SMTP subscription for identification and auditing
- `recipients` (List of String) List of email addresses that will receive notifications (minimum 1 required)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription is active (default: true)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the subscription (auto-generated by API)

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `category` (String) Event category (e.g., ACTION, ALARM, BOT, TIME_TRIGGER)
- `type` (String) Event type (e.g., TRIGGER)

Optional:

- `status` (String) Event status (e.g., EXECUTING) - optional
